claim.statement: The Devin 2.2 release note says Desktop Testing requests approval to QA a pull request and, if approved, runs a Linux desktop app with computer use and returns an edited testing recording for review.

values: Linux desktop app in Devin Desktop Testing

lifecycle.reason: The statement is preserved at the Devin 2.2 release-note scope and is not silently rolled forward.

limitations: This is a release-scoped publisher capability and control claim, not an observed QA run or current-service guarantee.
unknowns: Whether Desktop mode was enabled, approval was requested or granted, an app was run or a recording was produced is unknown.
